translated: I'd like to start talking about the story for this event, "Stars Hidden in the Night Sky."
I saw some people mentioning Saki in the comments earlier,
but how did you all find the story this time?
It really tugged at my heartstrings.
For Leoni... and for Leoni as a whole,
the ending really made me wonder what's going to happen to Saki-chan next.
First, I'll read some of the messages we received about the story and look back on it one step at a time.
The atmosphere was a bit unsettling.
Some people are saying it was an amazing story too.
Let me read the message from Mirin-san.
"I have so much to say about this event, but first, let me just scream..."
"She usually says what's on her mind or what she wants to do right away,
but when it's the most important thing, she can't say it. It's not good."
